text: Cute floating island, a garden bed with red tomatoes(?) and a white bunny. Says 'Tap the ripe crop'. Day 2, 10 coins, Lv1. Going to tap the crop.
Harvest gave +3 coins and XP. Sow then water worked, plants growing (2s left). Whole day cycle is 30 sec - already night. Now it says Tap a Momo - the bunny is called Momo, tapping it.
Assigned the farm tile to the Momo (1/4 tiles). Momo now 'Working at Farm' and harvesting by itself. Only one farm so other tiles are empty grass. Confirming with the checkmark.
Momo is now farming automatically, 6 jobs, income +9/min, coins 19. A mail icon popped above Momo and the Mailbox has a red dot. Opening Mailbox.
Cute letter from Momo proposing 'Field expansion' research. Love the letter style. Tapping Let's research it.
Research tree with tabs Farm/Lumber/Mine/Smelting/Power/Games... Field expansion needs 3 flask points + 20 coins + 20s. Need a research lab first. Tapping Build a research lab.
Build menu: Research lab only opens at Lv2 (I'm 54/90). Farm costs 10 and I have 43. Building a second farm for more income.
Second farm built on the right tile automatically and it's already growing. Second letter: watering efficiency. Adding it too. Almost Lv2 (87/90).
Hit Lv2. Tapping an empty grass tile opens the build menu. Research lab is now 40 and I have 66 - building it on the left tile.
Research lab building (4 sec). Now a hint says 'The island can grow here 0' pointing at the bottom-right edge. I have 35, need a bit more. Will wait for coins.
Research lab done, Momo is running Experiment there. Both farms ripe but Momo is in the lab. Have 47 coins, tapping the glowing sea to grow the island for 40.

Island grew a new tile at the bottom right with a bush. Info box explains building on empty tiles and demolish with bin (half refund). First line 'Watered, the crop ripens in a moment' seems out of place. I got 1 flask point. Got it, then mail.
3/3 flasks now, Start research on Field expansion for 20 coins (have 49). The flask points come from Momo experimenting in the lab.
Lv3 now. Hire Momo costs 100, I have 47 - saving for it since one Momo has to run between two farms and the lab. Closing and checking 'Next: City 0/4' to see what my goal is.

Status screen shows the goal clearly: to Become a City I need Land 9 (have 5), Momo 3 (have 1), Research levels 3 (have 1), Value 1.5K (have 162). Clear checklist, nice. Plan: hire a 2nd Momo at 100, then buy land at 55.

Oops, my Got it tap seems to have fallen through and opened the build menu on the empty tile. Harvests now give +6 (field expansion done). Mine needs 120 + Wood 10, so I'd need a Lumberyard first. Closing menu, waiting for 100 to hire.
Hired a second Momo named Mochi (100). Free time. Going to use the pencil to give Mochi the two farm tiles.

Research: Watering efficiency is 5 flasks/40/1m30s for -25% wait; Field expansion Lv2 is 4 flasks/36/30s for +1 crop. Going with field expansion Lv2 since it's quicker and directly more money. Mochi does 6 jobs a day now - nice that it shows the before/after.
142 coins, +132/min - growing fast. Buying the 55 sea tile at the bottom for the Land goal.
Land bought, island is an L-shape of 6 tiles now, another glowing sea tile appeared. 117 coins. Building a cheap farm on the empty tile near the lab.
153 coins already. Changed my mind - building a Lumberyard (80) here instead, since the mine needs wood and I want to see something new.

Lumberyard is up - a tree with logs, Fell/Replant actions, wood counter shows 2 already. Field expansion is Lv2. Starting Bigger harvests (8 flasks, 60, 2 min) - a new research type should count for the City goal.
Lv4. Third Momo costs 160 now (price went up from 100). I have 132 at +155/min, so waiting ~12s with the Hire panel open.
Hired Pomu (3rd Momo), Next: City went 1/4 - the Momo requirement is done. Trying the Assign button this time to see what it does differently from the pencil.
Assign button = tap one building; pencil = pick several tiles. Pomu now working the lumberyard, wood 8. Harvests now +9. Next goal: more land. Closing panel to tap the glowing sea.
Bought another tile for 70 (land 7 now, prices climb each time). 131 coins and 12 wood - enough for a Mine (120 + 10 wood). Tapping the empty bush tile to build it.
Mine is building on the bush tile (7 sec). Checking the new mail while it builds.
Bigger harvests finished -> Next: City 2/4. Mine is built and a Momo is already digging. Quickly starting Watering efficiency research with my 10 flasks for the 3rd research goal.
Started Watering efficiency. Got my first stone from the mine. Income +224/min, 188 coins. Greenhouse and Seed selection also unlocked. Time is nearly up - I'd buy more land next to reach the City.
